title: Repeats workstream, Phase 2: is purchased-screen feedback predictive of an independent measurement? (scalar correction prior + lambda x feedback)
written: 2026-10-04 02:37 +0800 (from `date`), before any outcome read of Phase 2; Phase 1 (provenance) read only design and plate-level day-1 columns
label: EXPLORATORY: Jaaks 2022 was opened by ../../feedback_validation_20261003; nothing here is confirmatory

data.access: outcome columns only after common.exposed_ticket(purpose, 'repeats'); panels via the frozen jaaks.build_panels (imported, never edited)
data.repeat_hierarchy: repeats/receipts/plate_hierarchy.csv (Phase 1): seeding event = (line, DATE_CREATED); one DAY1 group per event (606 = 606, one-to-one)

units: cell lines (target lines). Plates, technical repeats, seeding events, replicates SV/VS, seeds and folds are never independent units. A line's value = mean over the SV and VS replicates (and over seeds for seeded sensitivities).

i_same_condition_repeat.lines: the 14 repeat lines (Supplementary Table 2 'Replicate cell line' = yes)
i_same_condition_repeat.menu: the registered S x V menu of jaaks.build_panels (same split); replicate SV: screen orientation = S anchored / V titrated; replicate VS: the reverse
i_same_condition_repeat.event_labels: per (line, anchor, library, seeding event): QC as jaaks.py (drop SYNERGY_RMSE > 0.2 or LIBRARY_RMSE > 0.2 or missing Synergy / delta-Emax / obs-Emax); per anchor concentration mean SYNERGY_DELTA_EMAX over the event's plates and call = share of synergistic plates >= 0.5; label = 100 x max over concentrations; call = any concentration
i_same_condition_repeat.roles_primary_chrono: per (line, screen-orientation combination) its seeding events in date order: R1 = first (purchasable screen measurement), R2 = second (held-out independent repeat, primary evaluation), R3 = third (final evaluation)
i_same_condition_repeat.roles_sensitivity_reverse: R1 = latest event, R2 = second latest, R3 = third latest (lambda refitted on development with the same scheme)
i_same_condition_repeat.eligible_candidates: menu pairs with R1 and R2 in the screen orientation; R3 metrics on the subset with R3; a line x replicate with < 20 eligible candidates is skipped and recorded
i_same_condition_repeat.independence_status: taken from repeats/receipts/provenance.json: separate seeding events (different dates, own day-1 reference, dosing, read-out), mostly one culture expansion (CELL_ID) per line; NOT independent frozen stocks; plates inside one event are technical repeats
i_same_condition_repeat.history: other lines of the same tissue, registered pooled screen-orientation labels (all events), excluding the target line and, in development worlds, the held-out evaluation line
i_same_condition_repeat.folds: leave-one-repeat-line-out: for evaluation line L, lambda is fitted on the other 13 repeat lines, whose worlds are built on the tissue library with L's rows removed

ii_role_swapped.lines: all 125 lines, registered panels (SV and VS replicates); validation = the swapped orientation on disjoint plates (registered pooled label and authors' call)
ii_role_swapped.folds: 5 folds per tissue: lines sorted, permuted with numpy default_rng([20261004, tissue code]); fold = rank mod 5. For evaluation fold k, development = lines of all tissues not in fold k, with worlds built on tissue libraries from which fold-k lines are removed. Evaluation worlds use the full tissue library (registered setting: history = all other lines)

purchased_set.primary: top ceil(20% x eligible candidates) by the static screen-scale history mean (world.X_target[:,0], the registered history_mean ranking), frozen agent._top tie-break with rng seed = line index; purchased screen labels are the ONLY target-line observations any arm sees
purchased_set.sensitivity: uniform random 20% purchased sets, seeds 0-4 (mean over seeds)
purchased_set.never_seen: validation labels / R2 / R3 of the target line are never used to fit lambda, choose arms or build features; they are joined only for evaluation

definitions.S0: frozen TransferWorld(context=False) static prior mean on the screen scale (world.prior_target)
definitions.V0_static_validation_prior: shrunk history mean of the VALIDATION label of the same pair in the other history lines: (sum + k0*mu)/(n + k0), k0 = 2 (WorldConfig.shrink), mu = mean validation label over history rows. Target (ii): swapped-orientation pooled label. Target (i): same-orientation pooled label (equals world.X_target[:,0])
definitions.F_U_transfer_correction: frozen TransferWorld posterior mean (full mode, purchased screen labels) minus S0, at every candidate; used for UNPURCHASED candidates
definitions.F_P_own_residual: y_screen(i) - S0(i) for PURCHASED candidates (the candidate's own screen surprise on the screen scale)
definitions.model_U: V0 + lambda_U * F_U for unpurchased candidates
definitions.model_P: V0 + lambda_P * F_P for purchased candidates
definitions.lambda_fit: least squares without intercept on development lines, each line weighted equally (line-level means of F*(v - V0) and F^2, pooled over replicates): lambda = sum_l a_l / sum_l b_l; development 95% interval = line bootstrap within tissue (2,000 resamples, seed 20261004); lambda unrestricted in sign; lambda = 0 is a legitimate selected value
definitions.probability_mapping: continuous predictors are mapped to P(validation call) by a 2-parameter logistic regression of the validation call on the prediction, fitted on the same fold's development candidates

estimands.U: prediction of the independent measurement for candidates NOT purchased (what to buy next)
estimands.P: prediction of the independent measurement for purchased candidates (which screened candidates to verify)

U.U_V0: lambda = 0: static validation prior (strong static historical retrieval; also simple shrinkage with zero feedback)
U.U_screen_post: S0 + F_U = the registered screen-only feedback model (TransferWorld posterior on the screen scale, lambda = 1 on the screen scale)
U.p_pair: static confirmation probability: shrunk validation-call rate of the pair in history lines (k0 = 2, toward the history validation-call rate)

P.P_screen: y_screen itself (registered-style screen-only use of the purchased measurement)
P.p_cond: P(validation call | screen call) pooled over history lines and pairs (target ii: history lines of the tissue; target i: R1/R2 calls of the other repeat lines of all tissues)
P.p_cond_pair: pair-specific conditional rate shrunk toward p_cond: (hits among history lines with the same screen call + 2*p_cond)/(n + 2)
P.hits_then_screen: verification ranking only: screen calls first, then y_screen

arms.not_tested: single-drug functional probes (LIBRARY_EMAX, ANCHOR_VIABILITY), cell identity features and latent effect blocks are NOT mixed into the lambda model and are not tested in this plan

metrics.prediction: per line: mean squared error of the validation label; Pearson r within line
metrics.action_contrasts: per line: concordance (share of candidate pairs with different validation labels ordered correctly by the predictor; prediction ties count 0.5)
metrics.calls: per line: log loss and Brier score of the validation call (probabilities from the arm or its development logistic mapping, clipped to [1e-6, 1-1e-6])
metrics.ranking: U: validation-call rate among the top ceil(10% x eligible) unpurchased candidates; P: confirmed discoveries (screen call AND validation call) among the m = ceil(25% x purchased) verified candidates ranked by the arm
metrics.calibration: pooled over evaluation lines: calibration intercept and slope of the validation label on the prediction; for probabilities, expected calibration error in 10 equal-width bins and mean predicted minus observed call rate
metrics.yield: U-driven purchases: round 1 = top ceil(10%) by the static screen-scale history mean (identical for all arms); round 2 = next ceil(10%) chosen by each arm from round-1 purchased screen labels (history_mean, U_V0, U_lambda, U_screen_post); count validated discoveries (screen call AND validation call) in round 2

inference: per-line contrasts with the frozen verdict.contrast (stratified line bootstrap by tissue, 10,000 resamples, seed 20261003). Target (i) has 14 lines: intervals are wide and are reported, never a verdict
strongest_simple_baseline: per fold, the non-fitted continuous arm with the lowest development MSE: U from {U_V0, U_lambda1, U_screen_post, U_screen_static}; P from {P_V0, P_lambda1, P_screen}. Its evaluation-line MSE is the comparator; every fixed baseline is also reported separately. For calls: the probability arm with the lowest development log loss among {p_pair (U, P), p_cond, p_cond_pair (P)} and the mapped baselines

stop_rule.lambda_near_zero_tolerance: a fold's lambda is near zero if |lambda| < 0.10 (one tenth of the registered implicit lambda = 1) OR its development 95% interval contains 0
stop_rule.fires_if: for a target x estimand, EITHER lambda is near zero in at least half of the folds, OR on evaluation lines the U_lambda / P_lambda minus strongest-simple-baseline MSE difference does not have a 95% upper bound < 0
stop_rule.then: preserve the negative result for that target x estimand; do NOT add latent effect blocks, replicate-aware effect decompositions or more complex models
stop_rule.primary_cells: target (ii) estimand U and P, target (i) estimand U and P (chronological roles, R2 evaluation, primary purchased set); R3, reverse roles and random purchased sets are sensitivity analyses

posthoc_r2_check: recompute the registered post-hoc cross-orientation statistic of posthoc_mechanism.py exactly, and next to it the squared-error R^2 (1 - SSE/SST about the residual mean) and the skill against no correction (1 - SSE/sum of squared residuals); write repeats/receipts/posthoc_r2_check.json
outputs: repeats/results/phase2_<timestamp>/ (new directory, never overwritten): per-line records, lambda per fold, summary.json; receipts in repeats/receipts/
deviations: recorded in repeats/receipts/deviations.json; this plan is never edited after outcome reads (addenda only)
